theorem: The binary 90-D4 prism homology is a nonsplit 24-by-24 extension. The two 24-dimensional subquotients are not isomorphic through an invertible G-map: Hom_G(B,A) has dimension 2 and its deterministic basis maps have ranks 1 and 10. The independent E8/Kummer shared 48-root sector is not PSp-invariant, permanently separating the two 48s at full-group level.
boundary: No characteristic-zero irrep label is assigned to either modular 24-dimensional subquotient from dimension alone.
